description: Recommends shifting curbside and multi-unit recycling to SK Recycles.
Residents' recycling utility fees would be eliminated by 2028.
City to explore interim collection agreement before 2028.

chips.text: Staff stated achieving a 6% contamination rate under Option 2 is unlikely.
Future of city-owned recycling depots remains unclear.
Potential penalties for early termination of multi-unit recycling contract.
Administration will prepare a funding plan for the 2028 transition.

segments.title: Overview of New Recycling Program Options
segments.takeaway: Administration presented three options for the city's participation in the new provincial household paper and packaging program, recommending Option 3 with an interim Option 2.

segments.title: Council Questions on Recycling Program Details
segments.takeaway: Councillors questioned administration on funding impacts, contamination targets, contract termination, and the rationale for the recommended interim agreement.

segments.title: Council Approves Recycling Program Recommendations
segments.takeaway: Council approved the administration's recommendations for the city's long-term participation in the new provincial recycling program and exploring an interim agreement.

description: Committee recommends $300,000 from reserve for Lansdowne Avenue lift station design.

chips.text: Administration commits to design this year, construction in 2026-2027.
